proposal.profile: Data scientist who tests models honestly: trained separate models for 11,459 genes on one GPU, and showed on data they had not seen that they were overfitting. Builds the modelling a brief needs and reports its limits plainly: gradient boosting (XGBoost churn), LSTM time-series forecasting with time-ordered validation, text clustering (SBERT, K-Means, DBSCAN) and 11,459 per-gene models (train Pearson 0.807 vs test 0.545). Works with clients: scoped a loosely defined brief at 180 Degrees Consulting into a stakeholder demo (5-star rating) and contributed to the client's production MCP server, now in live use. Deploys on AWS (Lambda) with CI/CD and MLflow experiment tracking.

Builds the modelling a brief needs and reports its limits plainly: gradient boosting (XGBoost churn), LSTM time-series forecasting with time-ordered validation, text clustering (SBERT, K-Means, DBSCAN) and 11,459 per-gene models (train Pearson 0.807 vs test 0.545). skills.Machine Learning, Deep Learning & Statis: Machine learning concepts, statistical analysis (descriptive statistics, correlation analysis), predictive modelling (gradient boosting with XGBoost, random forest, scikit-learn), clustering (K-Means, HAC, DBSCAN, Leiden), deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, LSTM, BiRNN, CNN), time-series forecasting (cyclic time encoding, TimeSeriesSplit), anomaly detection (Isolation Forest), class-imbalance handling (SMOTE), hyper-parameter tuning (grid search, two-stage Bayesian), model evaluation (held-out, cross-validation, Pearson, MCC), statistical inference and experimental design (confidence intervals, bootstrap, hypothesis testing; MSc coursework), MLflow experiment tracking
skills.Python, Data Quality & Cloud: Python, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, SQL, PostgreSQL, R (tidymodels), identifier crosswalks, parquet, reproducible pipelines, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), serverless deployment (AWS Lambda), containerisation, GitHub Actions CI/CD, FastAPI, TensorFlow Serving, pytest, Git
skills.NLP, LLMs, Embeddings & Evaluation: NLP (text preprocessing, TF-IDF, SBERT embeddings, text clustering), Hugging Face Transformers, large language models (Claude, OpenAI, open-weight via Ollama), prompt engineering, RAG with embeddings (ChromaDB), agents (LangChain, LangGraph), team LoRA fine-tune of Llama, LLM evaluation (hallucination-rate analysis, deterministic guardrails)
skills.Client Delivery & Communication: Scoping ambiguous problems with clients, stakeholder demos, working with client engineering teams, code review, transparent reporting of model limitations, root-cause analysis, technical documentation
